title: record:history maps the entry's user from actor_name only, so activity rows written without it (every row before objectstack#22510's fix) read "Unknown user" although actor_id is set
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect, measured.** On `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0, every `sys_activity` row behind a record's History tab carries `actor_id` and no `actor_name`, measured by the dev of objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2044 and recorded on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22510. Filed by the objectstack triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) as the renderer half that card names. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (objectui `main` `8a55f0ccda`)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-history.tsx` (about `:195`) maps `user_name: r.actor_name ?? null`, with no other source. A row whose `actor_name` is empty renders the "Unknown user" fallback, even though its `actor_id` names the user.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#22510 makes the writer fill `actor_name` from now on. Rows already written keep showing "Unknown user" unless the renderer resolves `actor_id`.
- `recordActivityFeed.ts` (about `:773`) reads `actor_name` the same way, falling back to a system label. NOT measured.

## Acceptance

- When `actor_name` is empty and `actor_id` is set, the entry shows that user's display name. Use one batched lookup per page of entries (or the query's own expand of the `actor_id` lookup), not a request per row.
- `actor_name`, when present, still wins: it is the snapshot at the time of the action.
- Apply the same rule in `recordActivityFeed.ts` if the measurement shows the same gap there.
- **Pins:**
  - a row with only `actor_id` renders the user's name;
  - a row with both renders `actor_name`;
  - a row with neither renders the existing fallback.

`Clause-②: no`. Dedupe: search over objectui for record history "Unknown user" and an `actor_name` / `actor_id` fallback found only objectui#11701 and objectui#11697 (closed, the audit-log actor column), which are not this.
